text: In December 2024, North York Community Council adopted NY19.20, which approved an accessible parking space for a resident on Livingston Avenue. The approved space is in front of an old address for the resident, so the item needs to be re-opened so the space can be approved for the resident’s current address.

North York Community Council: 1. Re-opened item NY19.20, titled “Livingstone Avenue – Accessible Parking Spaces” with respect to Parts 1 and 2 of the decision of North York Community Council. 2. Deleted Parts 1 and 2 of NY19.20 and adopt the following instead: 1. North York Community Council designate an accessible parking space to operate from the 16th day of each month to the last day of each month, April 1st to November 30th on the north side of Livingstone Avenue between a point 51 metres east of Times Road and a point 5.5 metres further east. 2. North York Community Council designate an accessible parking space to operate from the 1st day of each month to the 15th day of each month, April 1st to November 30th and December 1st to March 31st on the south side of Livingstone Avenue, between a point 47.5 metres east of Times Road and a point 5.5 metres further east.
